Lindenmoor: 2,151,400 m³ ÷ 29,051 residents ÷ 365 × 1,000 = 202.8 litres per resident per day.

Kelmarsh: 1,739 ML = 1,739,000 m³; ÷ 24,117 residents ÷ 365 × 1,000 = 197.5 litres per resident per day.
